events.title: Crusaders capture Jerusalem
events.description: Crusaders broke into Jerusalem and slaughtered many of its Muslim and Jewish inhabitants. The capture fulfilled the First Crusade's goal and led to the Kingdom of Jerusalem.
events.html: Crusaders broke into Jerusalem and slaughtered many of its Muslim and Jewish inhabitants. The capture fulfilled the First Crusade's goal and led to the Kingdom of Jerusalem.

events.title: Poland and Lithuania crush the Teutonic Knights at Grunwald
events.description: King Władysław II Jagiełło and Grand Duke Vytautas destroyed the army of the Teutonic Order at Grunwald, killing its grand master. One of medieval Europe's largest battles, it broke the order's power.

events.title: Napoleon surrenders aboard HMS Bellerophon
events.description: Unable to escape to America, Napoleon gave himself up to Captain Frederick Maitland of HMS Bellerophon off Rochefort. The British exiled him to Saint Helena, where he died in 1821.
events.html: Unable to escape to America, Napoleon gave himself up to Captain Frederick Maitland of HMS Bellerophon off Rochefort. The British exiled him to Saint Helena, where he died in 1821.

events.title: William Boeing founds his aircraft company in Seattle
events.description: Timber merchant William Boeing incorporated the Pacific Aero Products Company, renamed Boeing Airplane Company the next year. It grew into a leading aerospace maker, builder of the 707 and 747.

events.title: Gianni Versace is shot dead outside his Miami Beach home
events.description: Fashion designer Gianni Versace was murdered on the steps of his villa by Andrew Cunanan, who had already killed four men. Cunanan killed himself eight days later as police closed in.
